title: Simple Factory Pattern
overview: Centralise object creation so callers ask for a type without knowing which class gets instantiated.
useCases: When the concrete class to create depends on values known only at runtime
Multiple places in the codebase implement similar type-to-class mappings
To centralise object creation logic and decouple callers from concrete types
exampleUses: A payment gateway that creates the correct payment processor (Stripe, PayPal, Bank Transfer) based on a method string
A report generator that instantiates the right formatter (PDF, CSV, HTML) from a user-selected output type
A notification service that returns the right sender (Email, SMS, Push) based on user preferences
